title: RSSB CET Graduate Level Recruitment 2026
description: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the notification for Common Eligibility Test (Graduate Level) Recruitment 2026.
shortInformation: RSSB has invited online applications for CET Graduate Level 2026. Interested candidates should read the official notification carefully before applying.

eligibility.qualification: Bachelor Degree in any discipline from a recognized University.

howToApply: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) if required.
Submit the form and take a printout.
importantInstructions: Read the official notification before applying.
Keep a printout of the application form.
Visit the official website regularly for updates.

faq.question: Who can apply for RSSB CET Graduate Level 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates having a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University can apply.

faq.question: What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18 to 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per RSSB rules.

faq.question: How can I apply?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official RSSB website.
